<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<!-- Audio credits: National Gugak Center, gugak.go.kr/digitaleum/front/phrase/list.do; KOGL Type 1 attribution. Samdonongakgarak: m9-601-n01, m7-601-n01, i1-601-n01, i4-601-n01. Excerpts mixed, faded and edited. See CREDITS.md. -->

<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>가을에 도착한 말뚝이 편지 · v4.4 검토본</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#694632;--paper:#f1dfc7}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;}
body{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,#fdf3e5 0%,#ecd9c3 75%,#dfc4a5 100%);font-family:system-ui,'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif}
main{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:min(100vw,1540px);height:min(100svh,900px);overflow:hidden;background:#efdbc3;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #4b2e2133}
/* All states live on the same image plane: no scene swap, no flash. */
.stage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:812/444;max-height:100%;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:#edd6b8}
.art{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;user-select:none;backface-visibility:hidden}
.closed-art{z-index:1;opacity:1}
.open-art{z-index:2;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6%) scaleY(.45);transform-origin:50% 78%;clip-path:inset(47% 10% 45% 10% round 8px)}
.stage.mode-opening .closed-art{animation:fadeEnvelope 1.16s ease-in-out both}
.stage.mode-opening .open-art{animation:unfoldPaper 1.16s cubic-bezier(.24,.78,.22,1) both}
.stage.mode-opened .closed-art,.stage.mode-video .closed-art{opacity:0}
.stage.mode-opened .open-art,.stage.mode-video .open-art{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 0);filter:none}
@keyframes fadeEnvelope{
  0%,29%{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
  68%{opacity:.65;transform:translateY(1.2%) scale(.993)}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(2%) scale(.985)}
}
@keyframes unfoldPaper{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6%) scaleY(.45);clip-path:inset(47% 10% 45% 10% round 8px);filter:brightness(1.06)}
  17%{opacity:.33;transform:translateY(5%) scaleY(.65);clip-path:inset(35% 8% 37% 8% round 8px)}
  47%{opacity:.92;transform:translateY(1.8%) scaleY(.91);clip-path:inset(14% 4% 18% 4% round 5px)}
  75%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-.4%) scaleY(1.01);clip-path:inset(1% 0 2% 0)}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 0);filter:none}
}
.click-cover{position:absolute;z-index:4;inset:0;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:transparent;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.stage:not(.mode-closed) .click-cover{visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
/* Only the play icon is clickable on the open letter, not the entire page. */
.play-hotspot{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:40%;top:35%;width:20%;height:31%;cursor:pointer;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.mode-opened .play-hotspot{visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
.play-hotspot:hover{background:#fff6e518}
/* The film appears *on* the paper, smaller than the paper's border. */
.film{z-index:6;position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:35%;aspect-ratio:1/1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.96);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;background:#fcf3e5;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #4c302540;border:clamp(3px,.55vw,8px) solid #fff9f0;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .32s ease,transform .32s ease,visibility .32s}
.mode-video .film{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
.film video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#1d1917;display:block}
.back{position:absolute;z-index:10;left:clamp(10px,1.6vw,25px);top:clamp(10px,1.6vw,25px);border-radius:50%;width:clamp(38px,4.5vw,57px);height:clamp(38px,4.5vw,57px);border:1px solid #b59676;background:#fff8ebdb;box-shadow:0 5px 15px #563d2630;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;display:none;place-items:center;font-size:clamp(22px,2.1vw,28px);line-height:1}
.mode-opened .back,.mode-video .back{display:grid}
.actions{z-index:10;position:absolute;bottom:clamp(5px,1.5vw,16px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:none;gap:14px}
.mode-video .actions{display:flex}
.actions button{width:clamp(38px,4.2vw,54px);height:clamp(38px,4.2vw,54px);border:1px solid #bb9a7d;border-radius:50%;background:#fff7e9e8;color:var(--ink);font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #57361e30}
.back:hover,.actions button:hover{background:#fff}
button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #a55d32;outline-offset:1px}
@media(max-width:700px){main{height:100svh}.stage{aspect-ratio:1.4}.film{width:40%}.play-hotspot{left:39%;top:34%;width:22%;height:32%}.actions{bottom:4px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.stage.mode-opening .closed-art,.stage.mode-opening .open-art{animation:none}.film{transition:none}}

.background-art{z-index:0}
.closed-art{clip-path:polygon(21.7% 20.2%,78% 17.5%,80.5% 80.5%,23.2% 85.5%)}
.flap-art{z-index:3;opacity:0;clip-path:polygon(21.7% 20.2%,78% 17.5%,79.2% 41.8%,50.6% 61.3%,22.1% 46.3%);transform-origin:50% 19%;backface-visibility:visible}
.stage{perspective:1100px}
.stage.mode-opening .closed-art{clip-path:polygon(22.1% 46.3%,50.6% 61.3%,79.2% 41.8%,80.5% 80.5%,23.2% 85.5%)}
.play-hotspot{background:#ad5e39!important;border:3px solid #fff0d5!important;box-shadow:0 6px 15px #59392255;display:grid;place-items:center}
.play-hotspot:after{content:'';width:0;height:0;border-top:clamp(9px,2.8vw,27px) solid transparent;border-bottom:clamp(9px,2.8vw,27px) solid transparent;border-left:clamp(15px,4vw,40px) solid #fff0d5;margin-left:9%}

/* v4.4: invariant image coordinates; no mobile crop. */
main{width:100vw;height:100svh;max-width:none;box-shadow:none;background:transparent}
.stage{width:min(100vw,182.8829svh);height:auto;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:812/444;container-type:inline-size;opacity:0;transition:opacity .55s ease}
.stage.ready{opacity:1}
.art{object-fit:fill}
.open-art{transform:none;clip-path:none;opacity:0}
.stage.mode-opening .closed-art,.stage.mode-opening .open-art{animation:none}
.stage.paper-visible .open-art{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:none}
.stage.paper-visible .closed-art{opacity:0}
.click-cover{inset:17% 19% 14% 20%}
.click-cover:disabled{cursor:wait}
.play-hotspot{left:42.6%;top:40.3%;width:15.8%;height:28.6%}
/* Measured inner frame: x 18–82%, y 14–84%; use conservative safe area. */
.paper-safe{position:absolute;left:21%;top:15%;width:58%;height:67%;z-index:6;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}
.film{position:relative;left:auto;top:auto;width:var(--film-w,60%);height:var(--film-h,100%);aspect-ratio:auto;transform:none;border:2px solid #fff9f0;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #4c302530;transition:opacity .2s ease;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;max-width:100%;max-height:100%}
.mode-video .film,.mode-ended .film{transform:none;opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
.film video{object-fit:contain;background:#1d1917}
.mode-ended .actions{display:flex}
.mode-ended .back{display:grid}
.actions{bottom:2%;gap:8px}
.actions button,.back,.fullscreen{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;font-size:23px;touch-action:manipulation}
.back{left:1%;top:2%}
.fullscreen{position:absolute;z-index:12;right:1%;top:2%;border:1px solid #bb9a7d;border-radius:50%;background:#fff7e9d9;color:#694632;cursor:pointer}
button{touch-action:manipulation}
.status{position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff7e9;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;color:#694632;z-index:20}
.status:empty{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px){main{height:100svh}.stage{aspect-ratio:812/444}.film{width:var(--film-w,60%)}.play-hotspot{left:42.6%;top:40.3%;width:15.8%;height:28.6%}.actions{bottom:2%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.stage,.film{transition:none}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<main aria-label="가을에 도착한 편지">
  <div class="stage mode-loading" id="stage">
    <img class="art background-art" id="backgroundArt" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" draggable="false"><img class="art flap-art" id="flapArt" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
